summary: This build's timed host loop invokes a complete row-parallel CSR SpMV per requested iteration. Outlined worker 0x1fd0 partitions rows by quotient/remainder and the inner arithmetic/backedges visit each nonzero in each assigned half-open CSR interval before the row result store; empty rows store zero.

source_evidence.claim: Parsed runtime dimensions/iteration count set the matrix and timed calls; CSR intervals are fully reduced by row kernel.

compiled_evidence.claim: Clocked count-controlled repeated GOMP_parallel at 0x1a39 / backedge 0x1a41. Worker symbol 0x1fd0 applies quotient/remainder row partition; per-row and per-nonzero loops and output store are contained in cited function, with explicit empty-row zero path.
